examples.en: "Regardless of discipline, employers are looking for individuals with the ability to multitask," says Fay.
examples.zh: “不管什么学科，雇主都在寻找能够做多种任务的人。” Fay 说。

examples.en: Women seem to be able to multitask better than men.
examples.zh: 女性似乎比男性更擅长同时做数件事情。

examples.en: Imagine you are pouring your heat out to someone and they are just busy on their phone, and if you ask for their attention you get the response—I can multitask.
examples.zh: 想象一下，你正向某人吐露心声，而他们正忙着打电话，如果你要求他们注意，你会得到这样的答复——我可以一心多用。
